rows.quote: MATERIALS AND METHODS: Discovery MR utilized protein quantitative trait loci (pQTL) data on 4907 plasma protein levels from 35,559 individuals, alongside genome-wide association study (GWAS) on MASLD from the Million Veteran Program (68,725 cases / 95,482 controls).
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the Million Veteran Program GWAS as the outcome dataset; the dictionary has no row for it.
Abstract gives UK Biobank pQTL data for 2923 proteins with no sample size, cohort subset or citation; the protein count does not separate the candidate rows.
